title: NO STRONGHOLD OVER THE FORGE
why: The Forge is placed at the raid build and the strongholds three seconds later. A stronghold could be a building that held the Forge, leaving it out of reach behind the shut gate. A building with the Forge in or within 70 of it is no longer a candidate. The old compound circle is gone since strongholds became real buildings, so this guards the building pick.
now: A stronghold is no longer a building with the Forge in it.
